title: turfc --registry-json, the diagnostic-code registry
description: IF-3, driver interface 1.14. Every code of the V-5 registry with its --explain text; the release archive carries it as share/turf/diagnostic-registry.json, and the website's error pages are built from it. Format 1: keys are only added, never changed or removed.

turfc.description: The release version of the compiler that wrote it.

default_level.description: An error is always "error"; a warning starts at "warn" or "allow".

since.description: The 2.x minor that added the code (2.0 for every code 2.0 shipped).

retired.description: Nothing raises it any more; its page says what replaced it.

important.description: Its message asks the reader to run --explain before fixing.

explanation.description: The text `turf --explain` shows, as written in docs/; null if the archive has no page for it.

explanation_source.description: "code": the code's own docs/errors/codes page; "category": the shared page for its kind of mistake.
